summary: performance lens over statement-model (20 product path(s), 3d57c3c..36daf1c, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 4 blocking, 1 non-blocking. The change leaves multiple core guarantees partial: mapping drift does not stop activation, incremental migration hides existing active budgets, and the repository still permits budget batches without snapshots. Its required warehouse proof also does not pin per-leaf monetary correctness, and outline construction bypasses the ingestion row bound.

blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Preserve active budgets when introducing the leaf projection (backend/drizzle-warehouse/0003_statement_leaf_projection.sql:1): The migration adds `leaf_key` as nullable without backfilling existing `mis_budget` rows or creating outline snapshots for existing active batches.

[P1] Make the outline mandatory for budget replacement (backend/src/warehouse/ingestion.repository.ts:61): `replaceBudgetBatch` keeps the new outline argument optional and the implementation defaults it to an empty array.
[P1] Assert exact monetary totals for each July leaf (backend/src/warehouse/statement-projection.db.test.ts:61): The gated proof checks only row uniqueness and two grand totals.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Include structural outline nodes in the workbook row bound (backend/src/ingest/mis-budget.parser.ts:121): Subtotal nodes are appended to `outline` and then skip the only `glRowCount * periods.length` limit check.

finding.summary: [P1] Reject mapping drift before activating the budget batch (backend/src/ingest/mis-budget.parser.ts:170): The parser only records missing master leaf keys in `validationResult`; `IngestService` then persists the rows and activates the batch unconditionally.

rejected_findings.reason: Contradicts accepted decision 0023: the drift check REPORTS and the upload SUCCEEDS. Refusing the batch was put to the human as an explicit option and rejected. Ingest is deliberately fail-open on drift and fail-closed on money (an uncomputed Budget cell still refuses, per decision 0020).
